description: JavaScript file implementing drag-and-drop functionality for portal portlets, including sorting, order updating via AJAX, and UI loading indicators.

methods.name: preparePortletBackgroundOrderChange
methods.description: Prepares and processes the change in portlet order after drag-and-drop, determining position and calling update service.

methods.name: updatePortletOrder
methods.description: Sends AJAX request to update portlet order on server based on drag-and-drop action.

methods.name: onCompleteRequest
methods.description: Removes loading indicator after AJAX request completes.

methods.name: getDocHeight
methods.description: Calculates and returns the full height of the document for UI purposes.

methods.name: onStartRequest
methods.description: Displays a loading indicator during AJAX request.
